result.summary: The street is a wide, multi-lane urban thoroughfare with sidewalks on both sides but lacks marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. The environment is dominated by vehicle travel lanes and on-street parking, creating a long and unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the asphalt encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, spanning the entire roadway width.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross this wide street safely between intersections.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with row houses and a continuous sidewalk that is in poor condition with visible debris and cracking. The environment lacks pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crossings, traffic calming, or dedicated lighting, and sightlines are partially obstructed by on-street parallel parking.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is uneven with significant cracking and accumulated debris, creating trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in front of the residential buildings.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians attempting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb side of the roadway where cars are parked.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface and implement a regular maintenance schedule to remove debris.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting focused on the walkway to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by 'daylighting' the corners.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane arterial road with no visible crossing infrastructure. Large vehicles, including a bus and a parked van, create significant sightline obstructions, while the lack of a median or refuge island increases the risk for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: A large bus on the right and a van on the left block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with continental striping to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the curb at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

result.summary: A residential row-house street with a continuous but narrow sidewalk and significant roadway pavement degradation. A large bus parked along the curb creates a major visual obstruction for pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large bus parked at the curb completely blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and vehicles in the travel lane.

hazards.name: Poor Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and uneven patching on the road surface could cause tripping for pedestrians crossing or instability for cyclists.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking of large vehicles near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and smooth the roadway surface to eliminate tripping hazards and improve overall safety.
